sections.kicker: Prepared for Origen by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Origen has a strong mark and a crew people like. Its words do not say what the food believes.
sections.keep: The wordmark and cactus mark. Bold, condensed and instantly yours.

sections.label: Front door

meet first.

pins.what: The bio is the descriptor every restaurant uses.
pins.why: Contemporary Mexican is a menu category. It does not say why Origen and not the other Mexican kitchen in San Diego.
pins.how: Write one line about the point of view in the kitchen.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: Diners choose between Mexican restaurants by distance.

pins.quote: Reservations are open. See you at Origen.
pins.what: The voice switches between a casual lowercase friend and a formal host.
pins.why: Two voices make Origen feel like two people running one account.
pins.how: Pick the voice from your best line and write every caption in it.
pins.label: Your voice
pins.cost: The brand sounds like whoever posted that day.

pins.quote: good things get named after good people
pins.what: One short line carries more attitude than the long captions.
pins.why: It sounds like Origen. It is the register worth building the rest of the voice on.
pins.how: Write more captions at this length and in this register.
pins.label: Your voice
pins.cost: The best line is an accident, not a standard.

sections.intro: You asked for a look at Origen. I spent some time on your Instagram. Three things stood out, and all three point the same way.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on Origen's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
sections.note: A few short questions first, then you pick a time. You can also just reply to the email.

reference: Patagonia, from another category. It lets the people and the place carry the product.
